1. Two panels separated by purple bar
2. Each panel has a 4x4 dark square (border c, interior varies)
3. Two green 3x3 squares that can move within their panels
4. Green centers can be W or c (toggled by clicking)
5. Left green is inside left dark square, right green is outside right dark square
6. There was a white square that disappeared
What if the goal is simply to get the right green INSIDE the right dark square? That would mirror the left side where the green is already inside.

Right dark square: rows 26-30, cols 44-48
Need to move: UP 10, LEFT 6

UP 10, LEFT 6 = 16 more actions, total 112. Still terrible but at least it would solve the level.
Actually wait - let me reconsider. What if the green needs to be at a SPECIFIC position inside the dark square, not just anywhere? The left green is at the CENTER of the left dark square. So maybe the right green needs to be at the CENTER of the right dark square too.
Right dark square center: (28, 46)
Current right green: (40, 52)
Need: UP 12, LEFT 6
Let me just do this and see if the level completes.
